title: Reversa Pricing Research
description: Result of a web market research generated by the reversa-pricing-research agent, consumed by the reversa-pricing-profile agent (hourly_rate) and by reversa-pricing-product (comparables, store_commission). The value only enters the profile or the product after the user confirms it in the calling agent.

kind.description: Research type. Defines the file name in _pricing/research/<kind>.json.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the creation or last regeneration of the research.

available.description: true when the research produced at least one accepted source; false when the engine has no search, the search failed or no source was accepted.

reason.description: Reason when available = false. null when available = true.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Mandatory in hourly_rate and comparables; null allowed only in store_commission.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of the accepted sources. Mandatory in hourly_rate and comparables; null allowed only in store_commission.

seniority.description: Canonical seniority. Used in hourly_rate; null in the other kinds.

city.description: City informed by the user, or null.

state.description: State or province informed by the user, or null.

region.description: Region for the geographic chain of hourly_rate. null when the user skipped it or in the other kinds.

description.description: One-line description of the software (comparables) or name of the store when store = other. null in the other cases.

model.description: Sales model compared in comparables. null in the other kinds.

store.description: Store researched in store_commission, or store of the model in comparables when model = app_store. null in the other cases.

store_billing.description: In comparables with model = app_store, fixes the unit of the sources: subscription = month, one_off = license. null in the other cases.

level_used.description: Geographic level accepted in the hourly_rate chain. null in comparables, store_commission or when no source was accepted.

levels_tried.description: Levels actually researched, in order. Empty outside hourly_rate.

queries_run.description: Search queries executed in this run, with or without a useful result. Limit of 6.

name.description: Source name, like Glassdoor Brasil or Google Play Console Help.

url.description: URL of the page where the number was read.

value_min.description: Lowest value of the source, already normalized to the unit. Equal to value_max when the source brings a single number.

value_max.description: Highest value of the source, already normalized to the unit.

unit.description: hour = hourly rate (hourly_rate); month = price per month (recurring comparables); license = price per license (one-off comparables); percent = store commission.

derived.description: true when the value was calculated from another unit (monthly salary / 160, yearly salary / 1920, yearly plan / 12).

accessed_at.description: Access date of the source, YYYY-MM-DD, the same in all the sources of the run.

note.description: Normalization calculation, geographic level of origin, plan name or publication date of the source. null when there is no remark.

sources.description: Accepted sources, in the order in which they were found.

reason.description: Canonical reason of the rejection, according to section 4 of research-policy.md.

skipped_sources.description: Found and rejected sources, with reason. Never converted nor used in the range.

range_min.description: Lowest value_min among the accepted sources. null when available = false.

range_max.description: Highest value_max among the accepted sources. null when available = false.

range_median.description: Median of the midpoints of the accepted sources. null when available = false.

confidence.description: high = max/min ratio of the midpoints lower than 2; medium = from 2 to 3; low = greater than 3 or fewer than 2 sources. null when available = false.

weak.description: true when there are fewer than 2 accepted sources. The calling agent warns the user before accepting a weak range.

disclaimer_en.description: Fixed text: market reference, not a recommendation; the value only enters the profile or product after user confirmation.
